title: History & Inventions Quest
subject: History & Inventions
description: Challenging historical breakthroughs, ancient civilizations, world explorers, and famous discoveries.

questions.question: Which ancient civilization built the Pyramids of Giza?
questions.fact: The ancient Egyptians built the Giza pyramids as grand royal tombs.

questions.question: Who is credited with inventing the modern movable-type printing press in Europe?
questions.fact: Johannes Gutenberg introduced movable metal type around 1440 in Mainz, Germany.

questions.question: In what year did humans first set foot on the Moon?
questions.fact: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Apollo 11 lunar module in July 1969.

questions.question: Which scientist discovered penicillin, the world's first widespread antibiotic?
questions.fact: Sir Alexander Fleming noticed antibacterial mold in 1928, leading to penicillin.

questions.question: The ancient Olympic Games originated in which country?
questions.fact: The ancient games were held every four years in Olympia, Greece starting in 776 BC.

questions.question: Who flew the world's first successful powered, controlled heavier-than-air airplane in 1903?
questions.fact: Orville and Wilbur Wright achieved flight at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina on December 17, 1903.

questions.question: Which legendary queen ruled ancient Egypt during its final Ptolemaic kingdom?
questions.fact: Cleopatra VII was the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt.

questions.question: What famous ship brought the Pilgrims to North America in 1620?
questions.fact: The Mayflower carried 102 passengers across the Atlantic to Plymouth Rock.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and the only person to win in two different scientific fields?
questions.fact: Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in Physics (1903) and Chemistry (1911).

questions.question: The Great Wall of China was primarily built to protect against invasions from which direction?
questions.fact: The wall guarded China's northern frontier against nomadic invaders.

questions.question: Which telephone inventor made the famous call: 'Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you'?
questions.fact: Alexander Graham Bell spoke these historic words over the telephone on March 10, 1876.

questions.question: Which Renaissance master painted the Mona Lisa and the Last Supper?
questions.fact: Leonardo da Vinci was a polymath artist, inventor, engineer, and scientist.

questions.question: What ancient code is one of the earliest and most complete written legal codes in history?
questions.fact: The Code of Hammurabi was carved into stone in Babylon circa 1754 BC.

questions.question: What was the name of the first artificial satellite placed into orbit by humans in 1957?
questions.fact: Sputnik 1 was launched by the Soviet Union on October 4, 1957, beginning the Space Age.

questions.question: Which English document signed in 1215 established that everyone, even the king, is subject to the law?
questions.fact: King John signed Magna Carta (Great Charter) at Runnymede in June 1215.

questions.question: Who developed the theory of universal gravitation after observing a falling apple?
questions.fact: Sir Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation in 1687.
